white-bread.definition: A soft loaf of bread made from finely ground white flour.

whole-wheat-bread.definition: Bread made with flour that includes more of the grain.
whole-wheat-bread.arabicTranslation: خبز القمح الكامل (خبز الحبوب الكاملة / خبز الأسمر)

baguette.definition: A long, thin loaf with a crisp crust.

sourdough.definition: Bread made with fermented dough and a slightly sour taste.

rye-bread.definition: Bread made with rye flour, often darker and denser.

pita.definition: A round pocket of bread that can hold fillings.

focaccia.definition: A flat Italian bread baked with olive oil and herbs.

ciabatta.definition: An Italian loaf with a crisp crust and open texture.

brioche.definition: A soft, sweet bread enriched with butter and eggs.

flatbread.definition: Bread made in a wide, thin shape.

croissant.definition: A light, flaky pastry shaped like a crescent.

muffin.definition: A small sweet baked cake, often with fruit or chocolate.

donut.definition: A small ring-shaped sweet cake, usually fried or baked.

danish.definition: A sweet pastry filled or topped with fruit or icing.

cinnamon-roll.definition: A sweet pastry rolled with sugar and cinnamon.

clair.definition: A long pastry filled with cream and covered with icing.

scone.definition: A small crumbly baked cake often served with tea.

strudel.definition: A pastry filled with fruit, nuts, or sweet spiced mixture.

macaron.definition: A small colourful almond meringue cookie with a soft filling.

profiterole.definition: A small pastry filled with cream and covered with sauce.

birthday-cake.definition: A large decorated cake made for a birthday celebration.

wedding-cake.definition: A large decorated cake made for a wedding.

cupcake.definition: A small individual cake with icing.

cheesecake.definition: A rich cake made with soft cheese.

chocolate-cake.definition: A sweet cake containing chocolate or cocoa.

carrot-cake.definition: A sweet cake made with grated carrots and spices.

apple-pie.definition: A baked pastry filled with cooked apples.

cherry-pie.definition: A baked pastry filled with cherries.

lemon-tart.definition: A small pastry with a sour lemon filling.

brownie.definition: A small rich chocolate cake with a soft centre.

chocolate-chip-cookie.definition: A cookie containing pieces of chocolate.

sugar-cookie.definition: A sweet round cookie made with sugar.

gingerbread.definition: A sweet spiced cookie often shaped like a person.

shortbread.definition: A crisp buttery cookie with a simple shape.

oatmeal-cookie.definition: A crisp cookie made with oats and often a little sugar.

wafer.definition: A thin crisp food often served with cream or ice cream.

biscuit.definition: A small plain baked item, often eaten with tea.

pretzel.definition: A twisted baked snack covered with salt.

cracker.definition: A thin crisp baked food eaten with cheese or spreads.

granola-bar.definition: A baked bar made with oats, nuts, or dried fruit.

flour.definition: A fine pale powder made from grain and used to make dough.

sugar.definition: Sweet white or brown crystals used in drinks and desserts.

butter.definition: A soft yellow dairy product spread on toast or used in cooking.

eggs.definition: Foods produced by chickens and used in baking.

yeast.definition: A living ingredient that makes dough rise.

baking-powder.definition: A powder added to dough to help it rise.

chocolate.definition: A sweet food made from roasted and ground cocoa beans.

vanilla.definition: A fragrant flavouring made from vanilla plants.

cream.definition: The thick fatty part of milk.

cocoa-powder.definition: A fine brown powder made from ground cocoa beans.

cinnamon.definition: A sweet-smelling spice made from tree bark.

honey.definition: A thick sweet golden liquid made by bees.

oven.definition: An enclosed heated compartment used to roast or bake meals.

mixer.definition: A machine that mixes ingredients together.

rolling-pin.definition: A smooth cylinder used to flatten dough evenly.

baking-tray.definition: A flat rectangular metal surface used to cook biscuits or vegetables.

whisk.definition: A wire kitchen tool used to beat ingredients and add air.

spatula.definition: A flat handheld tool used to lift, turn, or spread ingredients.

piping-bag.definition: A cone-shaped bag used for decorating cakes with icing.

muffin-tin.definition: A tray with round holes for baking small cakes.

cooling-rack.definition: A metal frame where baked food cools.

bread-basket.definition: A container used for carrying or displaying bread.

apron.definition: A protective garment tied over clothes while preparing meals.

timer.definition: A device that measures or signals the end of baking time.

bread.definition: A baked staple made from dough, commonly sliced for sandwiches.

cake.definition: A sweet baked food that may be decorated or filled.

cookie.definition: A small sweet baked food, often flat and crisp.

pie.definition: A baked dish with a pastry crust and sweet or savoury filling.

egg.definition: An oval food with a shell, white, and yellow center.
